name: comfy-mobile
description: Private mobile (Capacitor) client for ComfyUI: Video Studio + full node graph editor. Talks only to your own ComfyUI server.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run audit:privacy
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
